name: Universal Logistics - Nissan Integrated Logistics Center - Smyrna TN

fieldNotes.siteResolution: Confirmed via TruckMap, ImportYeti, Indeed and Chamber of Commerce listings as the Nissan Integrated Logistics Center operated by Universal Logistics at 200 Sam Griffin Rd, Smyrna TN 37167. A single very large (~1.5M sq ft) low white-roof warehouse running roughly NNE-SSW, immediately southwest of the Nissan Smyrna assembly plant. Roster coords landed mid-roof; locked center at 35.95250,-86.48480.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Z19 satellite of the SW corner shows a clear controlled checkpoint where the main driveway meets the access road: a small guard-booth structure straddling the lane with pedestrian turnstiles alongside, perimeter chain-link fence around the whole property. Street View of Sam Griffin Rd / the back access road confirms continuous perimeter fencing. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A distinct small booth-footprint structure sits in the truck lane at the SW entrance (visible in the z19 SW-corner crop) with the turnstile array beside it. Consistent with a staffed guard booth controlling a large auto-OEM logistics facility. guardShack = true; remoteGs = false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal driveway from the SW gate runs a long distance up the SW/NW face of the building before reaching the dock aprons - easily holds a 3+ truck queue. drivewayLong = true.
fieldNotes.docks: Dock doors are concentrated on the long NW face of the building; z19 NW crop shows a continuous bank of dock doors with many trailers backed in. Estimated ~70 doors across the NW face; flagged uncertain - the building is long and partly cut off in tight imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive marked trailer-parking rows along the NW side of the building and a second cluster near the NE end - dozens of dropped trailers without tractors. Clear dedicated drop-yard character. dropArea 50+, dropYard = true.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and generous internal driveway width at the SW entrance - physical room to add an express/bypass lane. fastLaneOpportunity = true.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Primary structure is one continuous warehouse; a smaller separate office/support building sits near the NE end - counted as 2. multipleFacilities left false as it is not a true campus of large buildings.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Smyrna TN is a small town; the facility sits in an edge-of-town industrial setting beside the Nissan plant with farmland/woods to the west and south. Classified Rural per the rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; CSX line runs east of the Nissan plant but does not serve this warehouse. railServed = false.
